game_title: Off By One Fixer – Herbalist Hut Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Mystic Forest – Herbalist Hut, a herbalist's hut: the beast tamer must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Herbalist Hut: a herbalist's hut
core_gameplay_loop: In Herbalist Hut, repeat each round: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the beast tamer ahead. Then check the fixes value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the root gate by solving code steps involving fixes that move the beast tamer forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the root gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Off By One Fixer
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
